answer_1.quote: Here, we introduce a new task, Visual Spatial Description (VSD), which generates text pieces to describe the spatial semantics in the image.
datasets: VSD dataset (built from SpatialSense and VisualGenome)
answer_1.outputs: text descriptions detailing spatial relations between two specified objects in an image

answer_2.quote: We report five standard evaluation metrics of the text generation for the VSD task, including BLEU-4, ROUGE, METEOR, CIDEr and SPICE.

answer_4.quote: Human Evaluation We perform a human evaluation to better compare the results of our proposed VSD models.
answer_4.guideline: The VSD outputs of each model are scored with the following three measurements: • Spatial Correctness: whether the spatial semantics of the generated text is consistent with the image? • Fluency: whether the generated text is readable and not different from human sentence-making? • Location Correctness: whether the input objects can be identified from the image according to the generated text?
